## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off for the [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/) (`git commit --signoff`)
- [ ] CI passes locally (`npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated if applicable
- [ ] React components stay CDN-free: no `external-svg-loader`, `data-src` placeholders, or hosted SVG URLs
- [ ] No web-font artifacts (`.woff`, `.woff2`, `.eot`, `.ttf`, or font CSS)
- [ ] License headers present on any new source files (SPDX header)
- [ ] No internal references included (internal hostnames, tokens, or internal-only tooling)
- [ ] `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES` updated if new runtime dependencies were added
- [ ] Version bump is appropriate: removed icon names or renamed exports = MAJOR; new icons = MINOR; fixes = PATCH
